notes: This is the official Go repository (compiler, runtime, standard library)
Build with make.bat (Windows) or ./make.bash (Unix/WSL) from src/
Use 'go install cmd/compile' after compiler changes
Run 'go generate cmd/compile/internal/ssa' after modifying SSA rules
Tests: 'go test <pkg>', 'go test cmd/internal/testdir' for compiler tests
Code review via Gerrit - use git-codereview tool
